preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 30, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(point in points for point in points)
postconditions.description: All points named by the program are distinct.
The program names exactly n points.

postconditions.expression: all(color in ['black', 'white'] for color in colors)
postconditions.description: Each point named by the program is either black or white.

postconditions.expression: exists(line for line in lines if is_valid_line(line, points, colors))
postconditions.description: There exists a line that separates the points into two groups with points of the same color on one side and points of different colors on the other side.

postconditions.expression: all(point not in line for line in lines for point in line)
postconditions.description: No points can belong to the line.

invariants.expression: points == [] or all(point not in points[:-1] for point in points[-1:])
invariants.description: Each new point added to the list of points is distinct from all previously added points.

invariants.expression: colors == [] or all(color in ['black', 'white'] for color in colors)
invariants.description: Each color added to the list of colors is either black or white.
The number of points and the number of colors are equal.
